title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
summary: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .
tldr: CLAP proposes a cross-embodiment action-conditioned video world model that learns universal physical priors from heterogeneous human and robot videos, enabling zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: CLAP提出了一种跨本体的动作条件视频世界模型，从人类和机器人的异构视频中学习通用物理先验，实现零样本部署到真实任务。
summary_zh: 最前沿的动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人本体，无法利用包含丰富可泛化物理信号的大规模异构视频数据集。为弥合这一差距，我们提出CLAP框架——一种跨本体动作条件视频生成框架，能够在涵盖人类与机器人主体的多样化互联网规模视频上进行训练。CLAP的核心洞见在于：无论执行者是谁，通用物理定律始终支配着时空动态。然而跨本体学习极具挑战性，因为不同机器人平台的动作表征差异显著，且人类视频中通常缺乏动作标注。CLAP通过以下核心贡献解决了这一根本性难题：首先，利用末端执行器位姿、语言指令与潜在动作统一了异构动作空间；其次，为克服各自局限性，CLAP提出基于课程学习的跨本体训练策略——先利用潜在动作从无标注视频中学习基础物理先验，随后将其锚定至末端执行器动作空间，实现真实世界任务的零样本部署。关键突破在于，CLAP在DROID等复杂环境中已接近或超越最先进的单本体视频模型性能。通过少样本自适应，这些优势进一步累积，为单本体视频世界模型训练开辟了新范式。最终，CLAP提供了迄今为止最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件——涵盖多样化动作条件空间（末端执行器、语言与潜在动作）及机器人形态（包括跨本体、DROID、Bridge、双臂YAM机器人及G1人形机器人）。我们已开源所有代码与模型，项目网站见https://omni-clap.github.io。

title: FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.
tldr: FlashVLA introduces a streaming action decoding framework that enables fast and asynchronous inference for flow-matching-based VLA models, achieving over 30 Hz control frequency on a single GPU while maintaining task performance.
tldr_zh: FlashVLA 提出了一种流式动作解码框架，针对基于流匹配的 VLA 模型实现快速且异步的推理，在单个 GPU 上达到 30 Hz 以上的控制频率，同时保持任务性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作领域展现出日益广阔的前景，但其实际部署仍受限于高推理延迟与不稳定的异步执行。这一挑战在基于流匹配的VLA模型中尤为突出，因为其动作解码需依赖于VLM上下文进行多次迭代步骤。尽管高效推理方法提升了控制频率，异步方法减少了执行空闲时间，但现有方法往往难以同时实现低延迟推理与精确、时间一致的异步执行。我们提出\textbf{FlashVLA}——一种流式动作解码框架，以统一形式解决上述双重挑战。FlashVLA维护一个包含多个不同噪声层级分块的流式动作缓冲区，并通过分块因果注意力机制对其进行解码。该设计使FlashVLA能够在每个推理步骤中生成一个可执行的动作分块。此外，其分块自回归形式隐式保持了动作连续性，使得无需额外未来状态条件即可实现平滑异步执行。在大量仿真与真实世界实验中，FlashVLA在显著提升推理速度的同时保持了强劲的任务性能，能够在单GPU上实现≥30Hz的控制频率，并在实际部署中完成平滑异步推理。

title: Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI
summary: We introduce Riemann-1.0, a fully causal autoregressive World Action Model for embodied intelligence. Riemann-1.0 jointly models multi-view visual observations, robot states, and embodiment-specific actions within a unified causal autoregressive sequence, representing robot actions and world evolution as causal state transitions. Unlike existing WAMs based on joint generation, video-first prediction, or decoupled modeling paradigms, Riemann-1.0 unifies online robot policy execution and action-conditioned world simulation within a single model, enabling it to function as both an executable robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual world simulator. To scale embodied experience across heterogeneous data sources, we further develop a progressive embodied pretraining framework that unifies learning from egocentric human videos, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and heterogeneous robot trajectories under a shared World Action Modeling objective. Built upon 200K+ hours of interaction data, Riemann-1.0 progressively transfers large-scale embodied experience into executable robot manipulation capabilities. Riemann-1.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. It achieves success rates of 94.3% on RoboTwin2.0, 99.0% on LIBERO, and 62.6% on the long-horizon compositional benchmark RoboCasa-365, outperforming the previous best method by 8.4% On long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks, Riemann-1.0 achieves a Success Rate (SR) of 85.0% and a Progress Success Rate (PSR) of 94.4%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 15% in SR. These results demonstrate that unified World Action Modeling together with progressive embodied pretraining effectively transforms large-scale embodied experience into generalizable robot manipulation capabilities.
tldr: Riemann-1.0 is a unified causal autoregressive World Action Model that jointly models vision, robot states, and actions, functioning as both a robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual simulator, achieving state-of-the-art manipulation success rates.
tldr_zh: Riemann-1.0 是一个统一的因果自回归世界动作模型，联合建模视觉、机器人状态和动作，既可作机器人策略又可作多种形态的视觉世界模拟器，在操作任务上取得领先成功率。
summary_zh: 我们提出Riemann-1.0，一种用于具身智能的完全因果自回归世界动作模型。Riemann-1.0在统一的因果自回归序列中联合建模多视角视觉观测、机器人状态和具身特定动作，将机器人动作与世界演化表示为因果状态转移。与基于联合生成、视频优先预测或解耦建模范式的现有WAM不同，Riemann-1.0在单一模型中统一了在线机器人策略执行与动作条件的世界模拟，使其既能作为可执行的机器人策略，又能作为多具身视觉世界模拟器。为了跨异构数据源扩展具身经验，我们进一步开发了一种渐进式具身预训练框架，在共享的世界动作建模目标下统一了来自第一人称人类视频、手持夹爪演示和异构机器人轨迹的学习。基于超过20万小时的交互数据，Riemann-1.0将大规模具身经验渐进地迁移为可执行的机器人操控能力。Riemann-1.0在模拟基准和真实世界操控任务上均达到了最先进的性能。它在RoboTwin2.0上达到94.3%的成功率，在LIBERO上达到99.0%，在长周期组合基准RoboCasa-365上达到62.6%，相比先前最佳方法提升了8.4%。在长周期真实世界操控任务中，Riemann-1.0实现了85.0%的成功率（SR）和94.4%的进展成功率（PSR），在SR上超过最强开源基线15%。这些结果表明，统一的世界动作建模与渐进式具身预训练能够有效将大规模具身经验转化为可泛化的机器人操控能力。

title: TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.
tldr: TemporalFlow-VLA enhances vision-language-action models for long-horizon manipulation by learning a compact, physically grounded execution history via robot-surface temporal flow supervision, achieving high success rates on LIBERO and RoboTwin tasks without extra deployment overhead.
tldr_zh: TemporalFlow-VLA通过机器人表面时间流监督学习紧凑的物理执行历史，增强了用于长时程操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，在LIBERO和RoboTwin任务上取得了高成功率，且无需额外的部署开销。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用预训练的视觉-语言表征进行机器人控制，但简单添加历史帧无法可靠地捕捉近期的物理变化。这一问题在多阶段操作任务中尤为突出，因为视觉上相似的状态可能因先前执行情况不同而需要不同的动作。为应对这一挑战，我们提出TemporalFlow-VLA，通过基于物理的时间监督学习紧凑的执行历史。利用记录的机器人状态、机器人几何结构和标定相机，我们构建机器人-表面时间流作为仅用于训练的目标，并监督两个与执行对齐的时间查询，为动作专家提供结构化的历史信息。几何监督路径在部署时不进行评估。TemporalFlow-VLA在LIBERO上达到97.63±0.26%的平均成功率，其中在LIBERO Long上为96.60±0.87%，在12个RoboTwin任务中分别达到85.5%（清洁场景）和84.2%（随机场景）的成功率。在更长时域、多阶段操作任务中，该方法相较于先前方法展现出最显著的优势。受控的历史干预实验表明，动作预测既依赖于历史内容，也依赖于时间顺序。通过异步特征缓存，时间条件化可在保持单帧级服务器端采样延迟的同时，不引入额外历史编码开销。总体而言，TemporalFlow-VLA提供了一种紧凑且基于物理的接口，可在无需部署显式运动估计或几何处理的情况下利用有序执行历史。

title: Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors
summary: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.
tldr: This paper introduces a modular reconfigurable robot that combines tensegrity-based compliant bodies with claw-based connections, enabling individual locomotion and self-reconfiguration into task-adaptive morphologies for cooperative manipulation and locomotion in real-world environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种结合张力完整性柔顺体与爪式连接机构的模块化可重构机器人，能够独立运动并通过自重构形成任务自适应形态，在真实环境中实现协同操作与多模态运动。
summary_zh: 能够根据不同任务和环境改变形态与行为的机器人，在构建自适应、多功能系统方面具有巨大潜力。模块化可重构机器人（MRR）通过单元对接与重组可实现此类功能，但大多数依赖缺乏结构柔顺性的刚性模块，导致能力受限。连续体机器人虽能通过柔性骨架提供柔顺性，却无法自重构为适应任务的多机器人构型。本文提出一种集成张力整体式柔顺体与爪式连接机构的MRR，融合了两类架构的优势。每个机器人可独立操作与运动，多个机器人可自重构为不同形态（如链状、环状、分支状），实现协同操作与运动。我们展示了机器人在多样化任务与环境中的能力，包括协调物体操作与运输、多模式运动以及真实场景中的运动-操作复合任务。这些成果为自适应多功能机器人集群奠定了基础，在制造、太空探索及搜救领域具有广阔应用前景。

title: GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation
summary: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them online to fine-grained biomedical tasks remains challenging. Task success often hinges on subtle, view-dependent visual cues, while task-level rewards provide little guidance about which regions matter, making it difficult to learn task-relevant visual grounding from limited real-robot interaction. Online adaptation is further constrained by the computational cost of VLA inference and replay-based updates. We introduce GRAFT (Grounded Reinforcement Adaptation for Fast Task Learning), a framework for efficient online VLA adaptation through grounded perception. GRAFT uses region-level supervision to learn view-specific visual anchors that focus perception on task-relevant local cues without requiring region proposals at deployment. It further combines single-step action generation with cached visual-language prefix reuse to accelerate online learning. Across four biomedical manipulation tasks, GRAFT improves success rates by 25 percentage points under matched adaptation budgets, while reducing the computational overhead of online policy updates.
tldr: GRAFT is a framework for efficient online adaptation of pretrained VLA policies to fine-grained biomedical manipulation tasks by learning view-specific visual anchors and using cached visual-language prefix reuse to reduce computational cost.
tldr_zh: GRAFT是一个框架，通过学习视图特定的视觉锚点和利用缓存视觉语言前缀重用来降低计算成本，实现对预训练VLA策略在精细生物医学操作任务中的高效在线适应。
summary_zh: 预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为机器人操作提供了强大的先验知识，但将其在线适配至精细生物医学任务仍具挑战。任务成功往往依赖于细微的、视角依赖的视觉线索，而任务级奖励对关键区域提供的引导有限，使得从有限的真实机器人交互中学习任务相关的视觉定位变得困难。VLA推理和基于经验回放的更新带来的计算开销进一步限制了在线适配。我们提出GRAFT（面向快速任务学习的基础强化适配框架），这是一种通过基础感知实现高效在线VLA适配的方法。GRAFT利用区域级监督学习视角特定的视觉锚点，使感知聚焦于任务相关的局部线索，且部署时无需区域提议。该方法进一步将单步动作生成与缓存视觉-语言前缀复用相结合，以加速在线学习。在四项生物医学操作任务中，GRAFT在匹配的适配预算下将成功概率提升25个百分点，同时降低了在线策略更新的计算开销。

title: Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling
summary: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.
tldr: A bimanual robot learns diverse juggling patterns online in under 5 minutes by combining a local learned model from experience with a global prior model for safe, efficient real-world learning.
tldr_zh: 提出一种在线学习框架，使双臂机器人在5分钟内通过本地经验模型与全局先验模型的结合，安全高效地学会多种杂技抛接模式。
summary_zh: 我们提出了一种在线学习框架，使双臂机器人能够在数分钟内直接在物理硬件上习得多种杂耍模式，即使存在显著的仿真-现实差距。本研究最重要的启示之一是：即使模型与真实环境相去甚远，它对学习过程仍极具价值。这催生了我们方法的核心理念：学习应建立在机器人现有知识的基础上，而非取而代之。我们提出的基于正则化记忆的学习方法将此原则付诸实践——通过累积经验学习局部模型，同时保留全局先验模型以推断经验稀疏区域。这使得每次新经验都能实现高效稳定的在线学习，无需在广阔的可能行为空间中进行盲目探索。对持续在线机器人学习而言，安全性同等重要——它使机器人能够在真实世界中反复练习和改进。我们构建了互达集合，使得连续抛接动作之间能够安全过渡，避免任一机械臂进入状态导致其后续动作需要突破关节或执行器物理极限。综合这些思路，配备多指灵巧手和机载视觉的双臂机器人，能够在不到5分钟的真实世界交互时间内，安全学习并组合五种经典三球杂耍模式：叠瀑式、网球式、半淋浴式、淋浴式与箱式。从更广泛的视角来看，这项研究指明了机器人发展的方向：基于不完美的先验知识，通过自身真实世界经验持续优化行为。

title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
summary: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. We evaluate our proposed approach across seven embodied environments, including three multi-agent environments where VLM planners coordinate through language while trained controllers serve as their actuators. Under matched observation and action spaces, our decoupled approach consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants, preserves fast control, and lets us swap in different pretrained VLM planners without fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks.
tldr: Proposes Instruct-to-Act, a system that decouples VLM-based high-level planning from a world-model controller for low-level control, enabling fast, language-instructable action in embodied environments.
tldr_zh: 提出Instruct-to-Act系统，将基于VLM的高层规划与世界模型控制器解耦，实现快速、可语言指令的具身环境控制。
summary_zh: 近期研究表明，预训练且经指令微调的视觉语言模型能够有效将指令与观测映射为高层规划，但在陌生环境中难以将这些规划转化为可靠的低延迟动作序列。与此同时，世界模型控制器在快速观测-动作控制方面表现出色，却缺乏开放式任务引导能力。本研究将二者优势整合至单一系统Instruct-to-Act中：通过训练世界模型控制器以高频率自主执行动作，其动作生成条件基于VLM规划器生成的稀疏、高延迟且高层的文本指令。为使控制器具备语言指令响应能力，我们利用合成指令重新标注控制器策略轨迹片段，并在现有奖励最大化与世界建模目标基础上联合优化行为克隆目标。我们在七个具身环境（含三个多智能体环境）中评估所提方法，其中VLM规划器通过语言协调多智能体，而训练好的控制器作为其执行器。在观测与动作空间匹配条件下，本解耦方法始终优于纯控制器与直接VLM动作生成变体，保持快速控制特性，且无需微调即可替换不同预训练VLM规划器，同时在七项任务中的六项上与强视觉-语言-动作基准及多智能体强化学习基线保持竞争力。

title: Beyond the Proving Ground: Independent Public-Road Testing of Assisted Lane Change Systems using LiDAR
summary: Testing of commercial Advanced Driver Assistance Systems is essential to ensure safety and compliance during type approval and in service operation. However, proving ground scenarios may not reflect real world driving complexity, while geo fencing can require manufacturer collaboration and limit assessment independence. This work presents a methodology for independently testing Assisted Lane Change systems on public roads. A campaign on the A31 French motorway used a test vehicle equipped with a LiDAR based vehicle detection and tracking system. Tests covered combinations of inter vehicle distance and speed between the test vehicle and the take over vehicle. Real time kinematic global navigation satellite system receivers assessed detection and tracking performance. Recorded lane change trajectories were compared with the lane change suppression requirements of UNECE Regulation Number 79. Of 27 predefined lane change manoeuvres, 18 were completed and 9 suppressed. In 6 cases, the system allowed manoeuvres that did not meet regulatory minimum distance requirements. In 3 cases, the deviation remained statistically significant after accounting for measurement uncertainty. To the authors knowledge, this is the first public road campaign designed to assess Assisted Lane Change compliance with Regulation Number 79 safety distance requirements. The results demonstrate the suitability of LiDAR based sensing for this purpose. The methodology can support market surveillance and future regulatory revisions by revealing real world behaviours not covered by approval procedures.
tldr: Presents a LiDAR-based methodology for independently testing Assisted Lane Change (ALC) systems on public roads, revealing non-compliances with UNECE Regulation 79. First public-road campaign focused on ALC regulatory compliance.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于LiDAR的独立方法，在公共道路上测试辅助车道变更系统，发现不符合UNECE第79号法规的情况。首次针对ALC合规性进行的公共道路测试。
summary_zh: 对商用高级驾驶员辅助系统进行测试，对于确保其在型式认证及在用运营过程中的安全性与合规性至关重要。然而，试验场场景可能无法反映真实道路驾驶的复杂性，而地理围栏技术往往需要制造商配合，且会限制评估的独立性。本研究提出了一种在公共道路上独立测试辅助变道系统的方法。在法国A31高速公路开展的测试活动中，采用了配备基于激光雷达的车辆检测与跟踪系统的测试车辆。测试涵盖了测试车辆与目标车辆之间的车距与速度组合。通过实时动态全球导航卫星系统接收器评估检测与跟踪性能。将记录的变道轨迹与联合国欧洲经济委员会第79号法规中关于变道抑制的要求进行了对比。在27个预设变道操作中，18个完成变道，9个被抑制。其中6次操作中，系统允许的变道未满足法规规定的最小安全距离要求；在3次操作中，考虑测量不确定性后，偏差仍具有统计显著性。据作者所知，这是首次旨在评估辅助变道系统是否符合第79号法规安全距离要求的公共道路测试活动。结果表明，基于激光雷达的感知技术适用于此目的。该方法能够揭示型式认证程序未涵盖的真实道路场景行为，从而为市场监督及未来法规修订提供支持。

title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.
tldr: FLARE introduces a retry-reset framework enabling vision-language-action models to detect and recover from execution errors in robotic manipulation, using offline failure analysis by an MLLM to train object-centric reset skills and an online monitor for arbitration.
tldr_zh: FLARE 提出了一个重试-重置框架，使视觉-语言-动作模型能够检测并恢复机器人操作中的执行错误，利用多模态大语言模型进行离线失败分析以训练对象级重置技能，并通过在线监控器进行仲裁。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在泛化至复杂、长时域的机器人操作任务方面展现出显著潜力。然而，由于这些模型通常在轨迹单调且无故障的演示数据上训练，其性能仍显脆弱。这种对"完美"数据的依赖使它们无法从常见的执行错误中恢复，例如抓取失败、物体掉落或意外碰撞。本文提出FLARE——一种通过"重试"与"重置"范式赋予VLA鲁棒错误恢复能力的新框架。首先，我们引入"重试"机制：通过向演示数据注入扰动并添加可将机器人位姿与环境状态解耦的桥接片段，使策略能够自主处理执行偏差。其次，针对关键性状态破坏（OOD）故障，我们构建了"重置"流程：利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）进行离线故障分析，从执行视频中自动识别OOD状态。该分析支持高效、定向地采集少量以物体为中心的"重置"技能库，并通过训练使这些技能能将环境恢复至任务有效状态。完整框架整合了上述学习策略：推理阶段，在线MLLM监控器在任务执行与"重置"技能之间进行仲裁。在具有挑战性的、高接触操作任务上的实验表明，我们的方法显著提升了任务成功率与鲁棒性。

title: Relaxation-Aware Multimodal Sensing of Soft Gripper Driven by Structure-Perception-Learning
summary: Achieving stable, sustained grasping with soft robotic hands remains a fundamental challenge. Compliance enables safe and adaptive contact, yet the intrinsic viscoelasticity of soft polymers leads to stress relaxation and a continuous decay of grasping force during holding. Inspired by human grasping, which combines phase-dependent stiffness regulation with continuous sensing and feedback, this paper presents an integrated structure--perception--learning framework. We develop a variable-stiffness soft gripper that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and the temperature field in real time, preserving continuous tracking of the interaction state. To mitigate relaxation-induced force decay, we propose a temperature-coupled viscoelastic force representation, together with a physics-informed learning model, to reconstruct the force trend and provide explicit compensation during holding. Experiments show that, in a 280s force-controlled grasp-and-hold task, the proposed method maintains the desired force with a mean absolute error of 0.066N, outperforming fixed-aperture and instantaneous-only baselines by 80% and 95%, respectively. Overall, the results support a mechanism--AI co-design view: mechanisms shape feasible interactions, while learning compensates remaining uncertainty in viscoelastic dynamics, together enabling stable, sustained grasping.
tldr: Presents a soft gripper with integrated structure-perception-learning framework that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and temperature, coupled with a physics-informed learning model to compensate for viscoelastic force decay, achieving stable sustained grasping.
tldr_zh: 提出一种集成了结构-感知-学习框架的软体抓手，利用机载视觉和红外热成像实时追踪形变与温度场，结合物理信息学习模型补偿粘弹性力衰减，实现稳定持续抓取。
summary_zh: 实现软体机械手稳定、持久的抓取仍然是一项基础性挑战。柔顺性虽能实现安全且自适应的接触，但软聚合物固有的粘弹性会导致应力松弛，使抓取力在保持过程中持续衰减。受人类抓取行为中相位相关刚度调节与持续感知反馈机制的启发，本文提出一种集结构-感知-学习于一体的框架。我们研制了一款变刚度软体夹爪，通过机载视觉与红外热成像技术实时追踪变形与温度场，从而保持对交互状态的连续感知。为缓解松弛引起的力衰减，我们提出了一种温度耦合的粘弹性力表征方法，并结合物理信息学习模型，用以重构力变化趋势并在保持阶段提供显式补偿。实验表明，在持续280秒的力控抓取保持任务中，所提方法能以0.066N的平均绝对误差维持目标力，相较于固定开度基线方法和仅依赖瞬时力基线方法，性能分别提升80%和95%。总体而言，研究结果支持一种机制-人工智能协同设计观点：机制塑造可行的交互形式，而学习补偿粘弹性动力学中的残余不确定性，二者共同实现稳定、持久的抓取。

title: SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page: https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/
tldr: SOLO introduces a Query Reconstructor and Trajectory-Aware MSE Distillation to enable stable long-horizon perceptive humanoid locomotion over complex terrain, achieving high success rates in simulation and zero-shot deployment on a real 1.5-km outdoor route.
tldr_zh: SOLO 通过查询重建器和轨迹感知的 MSE 蒸馏，实现了在复杂地形上稳定、长时程的有人感知双足行走，在仿真中成功率很高，并零样本部署在真实 1.5 公里户外路线上。
summary_zh: 人类能够在长距离复杂地形中行走而不失去平衡，而具备感知能力的人形机器人策略却因感知与控制误差的累积而变得脆弱。我们提出SOLO，一个统一框架，用于应对导致这种长时程脆弱性的两个相互叠加的原因：稠密地形重建平滑了动作关键细节，而逐点模仿缺乏时间维度的信用分配。其查询重建器（QR）利用傅里叶编码的单元查询，从深度-本体感知令牌中检索空间特异性证据，从而保留尖锐的地形边界。轨迹感知均方误差（TA-MSE）蒸馏将下一状态师生差异引入PPO奖励，使得广义优势估计能够将未来的差异惩罚传播至先前的动作。在仿真中，QR将高度图L1误差降低3.3-4.0倍，而TA-MSE在课程进度上超越了PPO与MSE+PPO。在压力测试地形上，SOLO实现了97.5%的平均穿越成功率与96%的踏脚石成功率，而稠密重建变体的对应指标分别为75.0-75.6%与0-3%。在仅使用胸前深度摄像头与本体感知的情况下零样本部署，SOLO完成了1.5公里连续户外路线与室内混合地形路径。项目页面：https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/

title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes
summary: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging and hard to detect. To support the new task, we propose an effective data engine for synthesizing high-quality target trajectories and an automated suite for measuring configured-failure fidelity. Then, based on this foundation, we construct two new benchmarks, namely Trap-LIBERO and Trap-RoboTwin, that instantiate Configured Failure Trapping across four representative failure modes. To address this task, we identify sparse action deviation as a critical challenge and accordingly propose a novel method named TrapVLA, which explicitly learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the configured failure behavior. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic settings show that TrapVLA effectively injects configured failure modes into VLA models while largely preserving performance on clean data. Project page: https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/
tldr: This paper introduces a backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, where a stealthy textual trigger induces a configured failure mode (e.g., a specific grasp offset). It proposes TrapVLA, a method that learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the target misbehavior, supported by a synthetic data engine and new benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后门攻击任务，通过隐蔽的文本触发器诱导配置的故障模式（如特定的抓取偏移）。提出的TrapVLA方法学习触发器引起的动作残差，引导策略实现目标故障行为，并提供了合成数据引擎和新基准。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种新型针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后门攻击任务——配置化故障诱捕（Configured Failure Trapping），其目标是通过隐蔽的文本触发器激活攻击，并诱导特定的故障模式。与将任意任务失败均视为成功攻击的传统后门攻击不同，配置化故障诱捕要求攻击者控制机器人的具体故障方式（例如，使机器人以指定的位置偏移进行抓取），这使得攻击更具挑战性且难以被检测。为支撑这一新任务，我们提出了一种用于合成高质量目标轨迹的高效数据引擎，以及一套用于量化配置化故障保真度的自动化套件。在此基础上，我们构建了两个新基准——Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin——在四种代表性故障模式下实例化配置化故障诱捕。为应对该任务，我们识别出稀疏动作偏差这一关键挑战，并相应提出了一种名为TrapVLA的新方法，该方法显式地学习触发器诱发的动作残差，从而将策略引导至配置化故障行为。在模拟基准和真实机器人环境中的大量实验表明，TrapVLA能够有效地将配置化故障模式注入VLA模型，同时基本保持其在干净数据上的性能。项目主页：https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/

title: Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning
summary: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found at https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors
tldr: This paper identifies 'Memory Anchors'—critical past experiences where new and old task representations conflict—and shows that selectively retaining or excluding them dramatically affects catastrophic forgetting in continual robot learning, achieving significant forgetting reduction on LIBERO benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文识别出‘记忆锚点’——新旧任务表示冲突时的关键过往经验，并证明选择性保留或排除这些锚点会显著影响机器人持续学习中的灾难性遗忘，在LIBERO基准和真实机器人上实现了大幅的遗忘减少。
summary_zh: 在真实环境中部署的机器人策略应具备持续学习新任务而不遗忘现有行为的能力。对抗这种灾难性遗忘的常见方法，是在训练新任务数据时结合先前学习任务的回放缓冲区。尽管该缓冲区通常从所有先前经验中随机采样，但我们发现其中少量经验对锚定过往表现贡献巨大。我们将这些经验称为记忆锚点。我们识别出记忆锚点位于新任务观测的表征与旧任务观测的表征发生坍缩的区域——即使这些任务需要相互冲突的动作，例如当必须以新方式操作熟悉物体时。在此区域回放旧数据对防止先前任务知识被破坏性覆写起着关键作用，正是这种关键的记忆锚点角色。在采样缓冲区前仅排除10%的记忆锚点，便会导致LIBERO基准测试套件上灾难性遗忘程度增加4.5倍以上。相反，用记忆锚点丰富回放缓冲区可将高冲突任务遗忘降低63%，并在真实机器人上成功实现两个任务序列的持续学习。视频及更多可视化内容请访问 https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors

title: Barrier Function Conformal Safety Clearance Certification with CVaR for Driving Trajectory Selection
summary: Autonomous driving motion planners generate and select candidate trajectories while accounting for interactions with surrounding agents. However, these evaluations do not certify the actual safety clearance of the selected trajectory. The framework evaluates the trajectory selected by ant planners and calibrates the gap between its plan time margin and realized safety clearance. A differentiable separating axis barrier margin deterministically lower bounds exact signed oriented-bounding-box (OBB) safety clearance, connecting the statistical certificate to safety margin. At plan time, the margin is evaluated using either a nominal prediction and sampled lower tail Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), while post-selection conformal calibration over exchangeable drive sessions absorbs prediction and sampling errors. Conformal calibration provides statistical validity independently of predictor correctness. The method is evaluated on a frozen 300 session nuPlan study using native Predictive Driver Model (PDM) Closed loop proposals. At 10% target miscoverage, sampled lower CVaR reduces the conformal correction from 1.43m to 0.03m and increases the rate of nonnegative safety clearance certificates from 68.7% to 87.3%. Across all evaluated statistics, exact-clearance coverage remains above the 90% target at 93.3--96.7%.
tldr: This paper presents a conformal safety certification framework for autonomous driving trajectory selection, using a differentiable barrier margin and CVaR to calibrate safety clearance with statistical guarantees.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶轨迹选择的保形安全认证框架，利用可微屏障边界和CVaR校准安全间隙，并提供统计保证。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶运动规划器在考虑与周围交通参与者交互的同时，生成并选择候选轨迹。然而，这些评估并未验证所选轨迹的实际安全间隙。该框架对任意规划器选择的轨迹进行评估，并校准其规划时间裕度与实现安全间隙之间的偏差。一种可微分的分离轴障碍裕度能够确定性地给出精确有向包围盒（OBB）安全间隙的下界，从而将统计证书与安全裕度相连接。在规划时刻，该裕度通过名义预测及采样下尾条件风险价值（CVaR）进行评估，而针对可交换驾驶场景的事后选择保形校准则吸收了预测与采样误差。保形校准能够独立于预测器的正确性提供统计有效性。该方法在一个包含300个场景的冻结nuPlan数据集上，采用原生预测性驾驶模型（PDM）闭环提议进行评估。在10%目标误覆盖率下，采样下尾CVaR将保形校正量从1.43米降低至0.03米，并将非负安全间隙证书的比率从68.7%提升至87.3%。在所有评估的统计指标中，精确间隙覆盖率始终保持在90%目标之上，达到93.3%~96.7%。

title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling typically employ fixed-size Vision Transformer encoders that are over-provisioned for simple tasks and under-provisioned for complex ones, with significant redundancy across attention heads. We propose Successive Capacity Growth (SCG), a method that starts from a minimal encoder (1 head, 2 layers, 283K parameters) and grows incrementally in width (adding attention heads for low-level semantic capacity) or depth (adding transformer blocks for higher-order semantic abstraction), driven by a task-agnostic test-and-verify mechanism that exploits function-preserving expansion to safely trial architectural changes and roll back if they do not improve prediction loss. The Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) ensures that all learned semantic dimensions remain statistically independent and aligned with the predictive objective, preventing collapse even as the architecture grows. On a 60-dimensional multi-object dynamics task, SCG naturally triggers depth expansion, improving prediction loss by 20.3% over the fixed small baseline with 56 times greater parameter efficiency than scaling to the fixed large model; on a 2D navigation task, a single width expansion yields even an 23% improvement over the fixed large model. Across all three tested environments of increasing complexity, the adaptive encoder matches or exceeds the fixed small baseline, with zero false-positive expansions and bit-exact function preservation (ratio = 1.0, absolute difference = 0.0). The take-away is that JEPA world model encoders need not be pre-allocated at maximum capacity - they can grow successively as the task demands, achieving significant compute and data efficiency while maintaining representation quality.
tldr: Proposes Successive Capacity Growth (SCG) for JEPA world model Vision Transformer encoders, which incrementally adds attention heads or layers based on task complexity, achieving significant parameter efficiency and improved prediction loss on robotic navigation and dynamics tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出用于JEPA世界模型视觉Transformer编码器的逐次容量增长（SCG）方法，根据任务复杂度逐步增加注意力头或层数，在机器人导航和动力学任务上实现了显著的参数效率提升和预测损失改善。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）在世界模型构建中通常采用固定尺寸的视觉变换器编码器，这类编码器对简单任务会过度配置，对复杂任务则配置不足，且注意力头之间存在显著冗余。我们提出渐进式容量增长（SCG）方法，该方法从最小编码器（1个注意力头、2层网络、28.3万参数）出发，通过任务无关的测试-验证机制驱动，利用保持函数功能的扩展策略安全尝试架构变更，并在预测损失未改善时进行回滚，从而在宽度维度（增加注意力头以提升低层语义容量）或深度维度（增加变换器模块以增强高阶语义抽象能力）逐步扩展。素描各向同性高斯正则化器（SIGReg）确保所有学习到的语义维度保持统计独立性并与预测目标对齐，即使在架构扩展过程中也能防止坍塌现象。在60维多目标动力学任务中，SCG自然触发深度扩展，相较于固定小基线模型预测损失降低20.3%，参数效率比扩展到固定大模型提高56倍；在二维导航任务中，单次宽度扩展即比固定大模型带来23%的提升。在复杂度递增的全部三个测试环境中，自适应编码器均达到或超过固定小基线模型性能，且实现零误报扩展与逐位精确的函数保持（比率=1.0，绝对差值=0.0）。核心启示在于：JEPA世界模型编码器无需预先分配最大容量——它们可根据任务需求渐进增长，在保持表征质量的同时显著提升计算效率与数据效率。

title: Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning
summary: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page: https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/.
tldr: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a task for embodied agents to rearrange furniture using egocentric observations and a top-down layout, and provides a benchmark and baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了具身场景重排规划（ESRP）任务，要求智能体仅通过自我中心观察和俯视布局图来重新排列家具，并提供了基准和基线方法。
summary_zh: 本文提出了具身场景重排规划（ESRP）这一新任务，要求具身智能体仅凭借自我中心观测和俯视图目标布局，将三维场景中的家具重排至目标配置。与先前的重排任务不同，ESRP禁止访问全局状态，并引入了物体间的相互遮挡，反映了真实机器人部署中的实际约束。这些因素使得将局部自我中心观测与全局目标布局对齐，在长时域规划中尤其具有挑战性。为促进研究，我们基于OmniGibson构建了ESRP-Bench综合基准，包含超过5400组场景对和8200个物体。我们定义了三个多层次指标来评估重排质量，并提供了四种基线方法：一种分层的任务与运动规划方法、一种基于视觉语言模型的方法以及两种基于学习的方法（IL和RL）。实验结果表明，现有方法难以高效完成该任务，凸显了ESRP作为具身智能体在场景理解与长时域任务规划中面临的挑战性前沿。本研究为在真实场景中部署智能体奠定了基础。项目页面：https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/。

title: STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.
tldr: STEP prompts a multi-modal LLM to explicitly estimate system states and predict state transitions for task planning in human-robot collaboration, improving action executability and final-state error in a simulated assembly task.
tldr_zh: STEP通过让多模态大语言模型显式估计系统状态并预测状态转换，在模拟装配任务中提升了动作可执行性和最终状态误差。
summary_zh: 在工业环境中实现有效的人机协作，要求机器人能够理解人类意图并协助任务规划，从而减轻工作负担。近期研究探索了在数据稀缺场景下利用多模态大语言模型（MM-LLMs）进行任务规划的方法，通过上下文学习解读用户行为，并生成自然语言的长周期行动方案。然而，MM-LLMs天然缺乏对系统状态的理解，且无法跟踪状态转换，常导致产生偏离预期目标的幻觉行为。此外，以自然语言生成行动方案易使输出停留在高层级规划，引入行动执行歧义。针对这些局限，我们提出状态感知任务估计与规划器（STEP），通过引导MM-LLMs显式估计系统状态并预测执行动作引发的状态转换。通过同步预测未来状态与动作，STEP既能保证任务收敛性规划，又能提供执行预测动作所需的辅助参数。我们在模拟环境中基于机器人装配任务评估STEP，其动作可执行性较现有最优方法提升32.8%，终态误差降低14.8%。

title: Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages
summary: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.
tldr: Proposes a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that uses a diffusion model and Bayesian optimization to plan a single shared support layout for the complete robotic disassembly sequence of irregularly shaped products, verified by real experiments with screwdrivers and shavers.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种模块化真空夹具系统，利用扩散模型和贝叶斯优化为整个机器人拆解序列规划单一共享支撑布局，并通过螺丝刀和剃须刀的实际实验验证。
summary_zh: 在不规则形状产品的机器人拆卸过程中，稳定支撑仍具挑战性。随着部件被逐步移除，可用支撑面、质量分布及任务载荷在整个过程中持续变化。针对某一工件状态设计的夹具布局可能在后续阶段失效，这促使我们需在整个拆卸序列中规划统一支撑方案。本文提出了一种基于模块化真空吸附的夹具系统，可为螺丝刀或剃须刀的完整拆卸序列规划单一共享支撑构型，使各拆卸步骤无需重新调整夹具即可连续执行。为在跨阶段反复评估的混合连续-离散布局空间中进行搜索，采用去噪扩散概率模型生成融合物理信息的初始构型，并通过贝叶斯优化进行精化。机器人旋螺丝及部件拆卸实验验证了规划布局的拆卸可行性，11项定向载荷测试则量化了其稳定性。通过测量操作载荷与方向响应之间的对比，得到螺丝刀的平均经验稳定裕度为66.9%，剃须刀为81.6%。结果表明，针对特定产品的共享布局可在所测试的机器人拆卸序列全过程中提供稳定支撑。

title: 4DSynth: Controllable Procedural World Synthesis for Dynamic Embodied Simulation
summary:
Embodied agents need environments that are visually diverse, physically interactive, and changing over time. Procedural simulators can generate large interactive scene collections, and recent 4D generators produce compelling visual dynamics. Combining these properties in one environment, however, still demands extensive manual effort, and the result is rarely editable or controllable enough to reuse at scale.
  We present 4DSynth, a controllable procedural system that turns a natural-language description, a blueprint mask, or a single photograph into an editable 4D environment with explicit geometry, animated actors, collision-free trajectories, and physics-ready simulation state. Multiple scene routes share one geometry-grounded representation, so the same pipeline handles animation, camera planning, rendering, and task generation.
  To validate the full pipeline, we construct 4DSynth-Nav, an interactive navigation benchmark generated entirely from 4DSynth's procedural scenes. Two vision-language models evaluated across three difficulty tiers both fail the majority of tasks and stall after early subtasks. The same procedural controllability that produces these environments also makes each failure reproducible and each difficulty axis independently tunable. This paper presents both a controllable generation pipeline and the scalable benchmark it enables, offering a practical foundation for developing and evaluating embodied agents.
tldr: 4DSynth is a controllable procedural system that generates editable 4D environments with geometry, animations, and physics from language/blueprints/photos, used to create the 4DSynth-Nav navigation benchmark where VLMs fail, revealing the need for better embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 4DSynth 是一个可控制的程序化系统，能从语言/草图/照片生成可编辑的 4D 环境（含几何、动画和物理），并构建了 4DSynth-Nav 导航基准，测试中 VLM 多数失败，凸显了对更强具身智能体的需求。
summary_zh:
具身智能体需要视觉多样、物理可交互且随时间变化的环境。程序化模拟器能够生成大规模交互场景集合，而最新的4D生成器则可产生令人信服的视觉动态效果。然而，将这些特性整合到同一环境中仍需要大量人工操作，且结果通常缺乏足够的可编辑性与可控性，难以实现规模化复用。

我们提出4DSynth——一个可控的程序化系统，能够将自然语言描述、蓝图掩码或单张照片转化为可编辑的4D环境，其中包含显式几何结构、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹以及支持物理仿真的初始状态。多个场景路径共享同一基于几何的表达方式，因此同一管线可处理动画、相机规划、渲染和任务生成。

为验证完整管线，我们构建了4DSynth-Nav——一个完全由4DSynth程序化场景生成的交互式导航基准数据集。在两个视觉语言模型对三个难度等级的评估中，两个模型均未通过大多数任务，并在早期子任务后陷入停滞。而生成这些环境所依赖的同一程序化可控性，使得每个失败案例均可复现，且每个难度轴均可独立调节。本文既提出了一个可控的生成管线，也展示了其支撑的可扩展基准数据集，为开发与评估具身智能体提供了实用基础。

title: Active Surface-Driven Reconfigurable Gripper: Robust Grasping and Sequential Manipulation of Thin Objects
summary: Robotic grippers face substantial challenges in grasping and manipulating thin objects. Most existing grippers rely on highly precise approach and grasp motions, which limits robustness and reduces applicability. This paper explores thin-object grasping using books as a representative example. Here, we propose a novel solution that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve stable grasping of thin objects without complex control. First, an underactuated gripper with an active surface is designed. The active-surface thumb performs in-hand repositioning of the target book without requiring adjustments of the robot arm or the other fingers, while the underactuated fingers establish compliant contact conditions with the environment, and the reconfigurable structure enables reliable grasping of books under different configurations. Second, we establish a kinematic model of the gripper, and determine the initial grasp postures for two representative scenarios (books lying flat on a desktop and books vertically packed in a shelf). Third, by analyzing the physical model of a book lying on a table and its interaction with the gripper and the environment, we systematically optimize the structural parameters and grasping strategy. Finally, extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed gripper and strategy. The results demonstrate strong robustness and adaptability when grasping thin objects placed flat (including books, paper, fabric, plastic film, and mouse pad), as well as a high success rate when grasping vertically packed books. Moreover, the proposed gripper can reliably complete long sequential "grasp-place" tasks.
tldr: This paper presents a novel reconfigurable gripper that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve robust grasping and sequential manipulation of thin objects without complex control.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型可重构夹爪，将主动表面与欠驱动柔顺性相结合，无需复杂控制即可实现对薄物体的稳健抓取和连续操作。
summary_zh: 机器人抓手在抓取和操作薄型物体时面临重大挑战。现有多数抓手依赖于高度精确的接近和抓取动作，这限制了其鲁棒性并降低了适用性。本文以书籍为典型案例，探索薄型物体抓取问题。我们提出一种将主动表面与欠驱动顺应性相结合的新型解决方案，可在无需复杂控制的情况下实现薄型物体的稳定抓取。首先，设计了一款带有主动表面的欠驱动抓手。其主动表面拇指能够对目标书籍进行手内重新定位，无需调整机械臂或其他手指；欠驱动手指则与环境建立顺应接触条件，可重构结构使其能在不同配置下可靠抓取书籍。其次，建立了抓手的运动学模型，并确定了两种典型场景（书籍平放于桌面与书籍垂直排列于书架）的初始抓取姿态。再次，通过分析平放书籍的物理模型及其与抓手、环境的相互作用，系统优化了结构参数与抓取策略。最后，大量实验验证了所提抓手及策略的有效性。结果表明：在抓取平放薄型物体（包括书籍、纸张、布料、塑料薄膜及鼠标垫）时展现出强鲁棒性与适应性，在抓取垂直排列书籍时具有高成功率。此外，该抓手能可靠完成长时间序列的“抓取-放置”任务。

title: MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics
summary: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.
tldr: MeshPriorDiT decomposes cloth dynamics into a structured mesh prior from GNNs and a generative residual from DiT, improving long-range coordination and reducing error in 15-step rollouts.
tldr_zh: MeshPriorDiT 将布料动力学分解为 GNN 的结构化网格先验和 DiT 的生成残差，改善了长程协调性并减少了 15 步 rollout 中的误差。
summary_zh: 基于动作条件的布料动力学预测需要同时实现局部合理形变与远距离协调。现有方法主要遵循两种范式。基于网格的图神经网络通过材料连接性捕捉局部物理响应，但其有限的消息传递范围限制了拓扑远距离区域间的协调，且自回归展开易累积预测误差。基于Transformer的动力学模型通过全局注意力捕捉长程交互，但通常缺乏显式的材料连接性，必须直接从数据中学习局部拓扑响应。我们提出MeshPriorDiT——一种将未来布料运动分解为结构化网格先验与生成性残差的层级动力学模型。首先，基于动作条件的网格图神经网络预测多步顶点位移，生成符合材料拓扑与抓取约束的参考轨迹。随后，以历史状态、规划动作及网格先验为条件，残差扩散变换器利用条件流匹配联合生成未被先验捕获的残差运动。生成的残差进一步通过材料邻接关系进行缩放与解码，以协调相邻顶点间的修正。我们在三项布料操作任务的15步自回归展开上评估了MeshPriorDiT。在三项任务的平均结果中，相较于纯图神经网络基线，MeshPriorDiT将全局均方误差平均降低43.42%；相较于扩散-去噪扩散概率模型基线，该指标降低75.03%，同时保持与纯图神经网络相当的边缘应变均方误差。

title: PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation
summary: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.
tldr: PredVLA is a sub-million-parameter predictive-coding policy for language-conditioned robot manipulation that achieves strong success rates on LIBERO benchmarks without robot-data pretraining, using prediction-error-driven latent inference for online state correction.
tldr_zh: PredVLA 是一种参数量低于百万的预测编码策略，用于语言条件机器人操控，无需机器人数据预训练即可在 LIBERO 基准上取得高成功率，并通过基于预测误差的隐式推理实现在线状态修正。
summary_zh: 摘要：大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型主导了现代机器人操作基准测试，但尚不清楚实现强语言条件控制需要多大的模型规模，也未知截然不同的控制架构能否在参数预算小得多的条件下保持竞争力。我们提出了PredVLA，一种语言条件预测编码策略，仅需68万个可训练网络参数且无需机器人数据预训练。其分层生成式循环动力学可预测视觉特征与本体感觉，而观测值仅通过源自感觉预测误差的在线推理影响潜在状态。在LIBERO基准测试中，PredVLA在三个短时域任务组中达到86.9%的平均成功率，在纳入长时域任务组后仍达75.4%。在采用相同冻结前端、演示数据、动作解码器和评估协议的受控比较中，PredVLA的平均成功率分别为参数匹配的Transformer策略和LSTM策略的3.7倍和7.4倍。该预测编码框架还使观测驱动校正的贡献可直接量化：由于观测值仅通过基于预测误差的潜在推理影响循环状态，禁用该推理即可获得精确的开环控制条件。这些结果共同表明，参数不足百万的循环生成式策略能在现代语言条件操作基准上实现强性能，同时提供由预测误差驱动的在线状态校正显式机制。

title: Arrive and Survive: Scaling Safe Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning from One-Bit Failure Signals
summary: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) scales effectively in goal-conditioned tasks by casting policy learning into a self-supervised contrastive objective. However, in a failure-terminated Markov decision process, established CRL considers pre-failure future goals only when constructing positive samples, without accounting for the probability mass removed by failure termination. Our theoretical analysis shows that this omission induces a systematic overestimation bias in goal-reaching values. Consequently, near-failure trajectories provide disproportionately strong supervision of success despite retaining little future occupancy. Unsafe actions can thereby be reinforced through catastrophic failure bootstrapping, leading to failed policy learning and unsustainable goal-reaching behaviours. To address this problem, we introduce two minimal yet strong corrections: mass-weighted InfoNCE corrects the overweighting of short surviving futures in critic learning, and a log-survival-mass score restores the missing survival mass in policy optimization. The resulting method, Safe Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (Safe-CRL), requires only the one-bit signal provided by failure termination to scale safe goal-conditioned policy learning. Across twelve failure-prone robot navigation and locomotion tasks, Safe-CRL consistently improves survival and substantially outperforms the Scaling-CRL baseline in goal-reaching performance. Additionally, deep Safe-CRL policies exhibit complex failure-avoidance behaviours. This study completes the CRL theory under failure termination and provides a scalable safe RL framework. The code is available via https://github.com/RomainLITUD/safe-crl.
tldr: This paper identifies and corrects a systematic overestimation bias in contrastive reinforcement learning for goal-conditioned tasks under failure-terminated MDPs, proposing Safe-CRL which uses only a one-bit failure signal to improve survival and goal-reaching in robot navigation and locomotion.
tldr_zh: 本文发现并纠正了在失败终止的马尔可夫决策过程中，对比强化学习对目标达成价值的系统性高估偏差，提出了Safe-CRL方法，仅利用一位失败信号即可在机器人导航和 locomotion 任务中提高生存率和目标达成性能。
summary_zh: 对比强化学习通过将策略学习转化为自监督对比目标，在目标条件化任务中实现了有效的扩展。然而，在失败终止的马尔可夫决策过程中，现有对比强化学习在构建正样本时仅考虑失败前的未来目标，而未考虑失败终止所移除的概率质量。我们的理论分析表明，这种忽略会在目标达成价值中引发系统性的高估偏差。因此，濒临失败的轨迹尽管保留极少的未来占用概率，却提供了不成比例的强成功监督信号。这可能导致不安全行为通过灾难性失败启动得到强化，进而造成策略学习失败以及不可持续的目标达成行为。为解决该问题，我们引入了两项最小但有效的修正：质量加权InfoNCE纠正了评论家学习中短生存期未来轨迹的过加权问题，而对数生存质量分数则在策略优化中恢复了缺失的生存质量。由此提出的安全对比强化学习方法仅需利用失败终止提供的单比特信号，即可实现安全的目标条件化策略学习扩展。在十二项易失败的机器人导航与移动任务中，安全对比强化学习持续提升了生存率，并在目标达成性能上显著优于扩展对比强化学习基线。此外，深度安全对比强化学习策略展现出复杂的避障行为。本研究完善了失败终止条件下的对比强化学习理论，并提供了一个可扩展的安全强化学习框架。代码可通过 https://github.com/RomainLITUD/safe-crl 获取。

title: Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions
summary: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.
tldr: This paper presents the first closed-loop walking controller for the Poppy Humanoid robot, using LQR trajectory tracking with a learned quadratic cost function from open-loop data, achieving statistically significant improvements over open-loop playback.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了首个用于Poppy人形机器人的闭环行走控制器，基于LQR轨迹跟踪和从开环数据中学习的二次代价函数，相比开环回放实现了统计显著的性能提升。
summary_zh: Poppy人形机器人是一款适用于人工智能研究与教育的开源低成本机器人平台。然而，目前尚未有公开文献报道能在标准Poppy硬件上实现可靠、无辅助双足步行的成熟方法。本文提出了一种基于线性二次型调节器（LQR）框架的轨迹跟踪闭环行走控制器。通过从标称行走轨迹的开环回放数据出发，该方法学习得到适用于LQR控制器的二次型代价函数，显著提升了运动的可靠性。经实验验证，该闭环控制器相比开环轨迹回放，在行走性能上表现出具有统计显著性的提升。

title: RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav, a simple but effective architecture that treats inference latency, asynchronous environment stepping, and bounded compute as explicit design considerations. Evaluated on real-time variants of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, RTNav improves the success rate by up to 11% and the Success weighted by Completion Time by up to 5.1 points over prior work.
tldr: RTNav is a real-time zero-shot object navigation architecture that explicitly accounts for inference latency, asynchronous stepping, and bounded compute, achieving improved success rate and efficiency in real-time variants of HM3D benchmarks.
tldr_zh: RTNav是一种实时零样本物体导航架构，显式考虑了推理延迟、异步环境步进和有限计算资源，在HM3D的实时变体基准上提升了成功率和效率。
summary_zh: 在未知环境中导航以寻找未预见物体，借助强大的视觉与语言基础模型已愈发可行。然而，这些模型也引入了不可忽视的推理延迟，当智能体需在真实世界中持续运行时，这成为重要考量因素。当前多数先进方法仍基于同步模拟器开发——模拟环境会等待智能体执行动作，因此推理时间可视为零成本。这导致智能体的设计往往遵循"感知-推理-动作"的串行执行逻辑，鲜少考虑时间约束。在实时执行场景中，挂钟时间会计入任务预算，此类架构的低效性便暴露无遗。我们证明，近期零样本物体导航方法在此类真实时序条件下会出现持续性的性能退化。基于此发现，我们提出RTNav——一种简洁高效的架构，将推理延迟、异步环境步进与有限算力作为显式设计考量。在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2及HM3D-OVON的实时变体测试中，RTNav相较于先前方法，成功率最高提升11%，以完成时间加权的成功率指标最高提升5.1个百分点。

title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model's predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.
tldr: This paper introduces PAWBench, a benchmark to evaluate whether video generation models, when used as world models, can correctly reproduce the distribution of possible outcomes given the same initial observation and action, and reveals that current models fail to achieve this probabilistic alignment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了PAWBench，用于评估视频生成模型作为世界模型时，能否在相同初始观察和动作下正确复现可能结果的分布，并揭示当前模型未能实现这种概率对齐。
summary_zh: 近期视频生成模型越来越多地被构建为世界模型。许多物理过程可能以多种有效方式展开。因此，一个世界模型不仅应再现一条合理的轨迹，还应再现相同初始观测与行动下可能行为的分布。我们将这种分布层面的要求称为概率对齐。然而，现有评估主要衡量单段视频的合理性，并未检验重复生成是否恢复了正确的分布。这引出一个核心问题：当前视频生成器距离概率对齐的世界建模还有多远？为回答该问题，我们将概率对齐形式化为世界模型的分布标准，并引入PAWBench——一个用于评估视频生成器作为世界动力学随机采样器的基准。我们进一步提出PAWEval，一种结果层级的协议，该协议将重复视频生成过程转化为关于可能物理行为的经验分布。在50个场景和11个现有系统中，没有任何模型在恢复有效行为范围的同时始终匹配参考概率。在明确这一差距后，我们检验了语言提示、初始噪声采样或模型训练是否能够重塑模型的预测分布。我们相信，本研究可为未来向概率对齐世界建模方向的发展奠定基础。

title: DPA-I2P: Depth-Guided Projective Alignment for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration in Autonomous Driving
summary: Image-to-Point Cloud Registration aims to estimate the camera pose of a given image within a 3D scene point cloud, which is a fundamental task in autonomous driving and large-scale outdoor localization. Recent implicit correspondence learning methods have improved registration performance by learning cross-modal alignment in an end-to-end framework, leading to more accurate camera pose estimation. However, due to the inherent modality discrepancy between images and sparse LiDAR point clouds, reliable cross-modal correspondence learning remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose Depth-Guided Projective Alignment for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration (DPA-I2P). Unlike naive depth or feature concatenation, Ray-Conditioned Metric Depth Encoding (RMDE) and Projection-Consistent Vision Lifting (PVL) exploit depth and visual cues in a structured, geometry-aware manner. In addition, Cross-Modal Query Pruning (CQP) suppresses unreliable queries during early refinement to improve matching stability. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. On KITTI, DPA-I2P reduces RTE and RRE by 45.0% and 55.6% over the strongest implicit baseline, respectively. On nuScenes, DPA-I2P also improves registration accuracy over the evaluated baselines, suggesting better transferability to different driving scenes.
tldr: DPA-I2P proposes a depth-guided projective alignment method for image-to-point-cloud registration in autonomous driving, using ray-conditioned metric depth encoding and projection-consistent vision lifting to improve cross-modal correspondence, achieving large reductions in rotation and translation error on KITTI and nuScenes.
tldr_zh: DPA-I2P提出了一种深度引导的投影对齐方法，用于自动驾驶中的图像到点云配准，通过光线条件度量深度编码和投影一致性视觉提升改善跨模态对应，在KITTI和nuScenes上大幅降低了旋转和平移误差。
summary_zh: 图像到点云配准旨在估计给定图像在三维场景点云中的相机位姿，这是自动驾驶和大规模室外定位中的一项基础任务。近期，基于隐式对应学习的方法通过端到端框架学习跨模态对齐，提升了配准性能，实现了更精确的相机位姿估计。然而，由于图像与稀疏激光雷达点云之间固有的模态差异，可靠的跨模态对应学习仍面临挑战。针对该问题，本文提出深度引导的投影对齐图像-点云配准方法（DPA-I2P）。与简单的深度或特征拼接不同，光线条件化度量深度编码（RMDE）与投影一致性视觉提升（PVL）以结构化且几何感知的方式利用深度与视觉线索。此外，跨模态查询剪枝（CQP）在早期精化阶段抑制不可靠查询，以提升匹配稳定性。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。在KITTI上，DPA-I2P相较于最强隐式基线分别降低了45.0%的平移误差（RTE）和55.6%的旋转误差（RRE）。在nuScenes上，DPA-I2P相较于评估基线同样提升了配准精度，表明其对不同驾驶场景具有更优的迁移能力。

title: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.
tldr: This paper introduces the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which uses operator-structured transitions to model latent evolution in World Action Models, improving closed-loop performance and robustness in robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了潜在演化算子网络（LEON），通过算子结构的转换来建模世界动作模型中的潜在演化，提升了机器人操作的闭环性能和鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 世界行动模型通过预测任务相关场景状态在交互作用下的演化过程来增强机器人策略。当前的世界行动模型越来越多地在潜在表示空间中进行此类预测，既避免了完整外观层面的生成，又保留了控制相关的信息。然而，潜在状态转换通常通过基于Transformer的预测器实现，其归纳结构以令牌交互为核心而非时间演化。我们将转换实现视为一种独立于预测表示和预测-策略耦合的架构选择，并提出潜在演化算子网络。该网络通过基于上下文调制的算子传播与加性强迫，在可学习的观测空间中建模潜在演化。基于受控Koopman生成元视角的演化理论，潜在演化算子网络将上下文相关的转换变体组织在共享演化算子结构周围，同时保留加性变化的补充路径。受控动力系统验证了这种演化特异性归纳偏差以及算子传播与强迫的互补作用。在两种将潜在预测以不同方式整合进策略的世界行动模型架构中，潜在演化算子网络提升了闭环性能与鲁棒性，并在完全替换转换模块时仍保持有效性。这些结果确立了转换实现作为潜在世界行动模型中具有重要影响的架构选择。

title: Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation
summary: Robot crowd navigation requires safe and efficient decision-making under dense, dynamic, and multimodal human--robot interactions. Existing reinforcement-learning methods typically output a single reactive action at each timestep, which limits their ability to represent diverse short-term avoidance strategies. We propose Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online reinforcement-learning framework that uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for crowd navigation. PDPO is first pretrained on collision-avoidance demonstrations and then fine-tuned online with PPO by treating the denoising process as an internal decision process. During execution, the policy generates a five-step action chunk and applies it in a receding-horizon manner. Furthermore, we observe an evaluation artifact in common crowd-navigation benchmarks: without explicit boundary constraints, learned agents may leave the valid domain and bypass dense crowds. To address this, we introduce a setting in which boundary violations are treated as collisions. Experiments show that PDPO obtains an improved success rate over strong baselines, and ablations demonstrate that action chunks are especially important for the modified bounded benchmark.
tldr: Proposes PDPO, an offline-to-online RL framework using a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for robot crowd navigation, and introduces a bounded benchmark to fix an evaluation artifact.
tldr_zh: 提出PDPO，一种利用扩散策略生成短视动作块的离线到在线强化学习框架用于机器人人群导航，并引入有界基准以修复评估伪影。
summary_zh: 机器人人群导航需要在密集、动态且多模式的人机交互环境下做出安全高效的决策。现有的强化学习方法通常在每一步仅输出单一反应性动作，这限制了其表示多种短期避让策略的能力。我们提出了规划扩散策略优化（PDPO），这是一种离线到在线的强化学习框架，利用扩散策略为人群导航生成短时域动作块。PDPO首先在避碰演示上进行预训练，然后通过将去噪过程视为内部决策过程，使用PPO进行在线微调。在执行过程中，该策略生成一个五步动作块，并以滚动时域的方式应用。此外，我们在常见的人群导航基准中发现一个评估偏差：若缺乏明确的边界约束，学习型智能体可能会离开有效区域并绕过密集人群。为解决此问题，我们引入了一种将边界违规视为碰撞的设置。实验表明，PDPO相较于强基线获得了更高的成功率，而消融实验则证明动作块对于修改后的有界基准尤为重要。

title: Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress
summary:
While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.
  A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. The platform enables automated, repeatable, and spatially resolved physiological measurements that go beyond passive imaging. By tightly coupling perception, geometric reasoning, and manipulation, the proposed system provides a robotics-driven approach to high-resolution plant phenotyping and opens new directions for autonomous agricultural inspection and plant-aware manipulation.
tldr: This paper presents an autonomous robotic platform that integrates active physiological sensing (chlorophyll fluorescence) with 3D reconstruction and motion planning to characterize plant stress at high resolution.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种自主机器人平台，通过结合主动生理传感（叶绿素荧光）、三维重建和运动规划，实现对植物胁迫的高分辨率表征。
summary_zh:
大多数表型分析平台主要依赖基于图像的测量手段，而先进的植物表征需要整合叶绿素荧光等主动生理传感模态。本文提出一种自主机器人平台，旨在对植物叶片进行目标性荧光测量。该系统融合了三维植物重建、几何分析与运动规划技术，可定位合适的测量点，并为机械臂生成无碰撞轨迹。

通过多视角数据构建植物的密集三维模型，并基于方向、可达性及传感约束条件，提取候选叶片表面。这些目标点随后被集成到任务级规划框架中，引导末端执行器达到点式荧光采集所需的精确接触或近接触位形。该平台能够实现超越被动成像的自动化、可重复且具有空间分辨率的生理测量。通过紧密耦合感知、几何推理与操控能力，所提系统为高分辨率植物表型分析提供了机器人驱动的新方法，并为自主农业巡检及植物感知型操控开辟了新方向。

title: Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics
summary: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-driven environmental variability, and physically based underwater optics. These additions are designed to better capture the forces and measurements shaping the behavior of deep-ocean AUVs, ROVs, landers, ASVs, and gliders, while remaining compatible with real-time simulation. This work advances underwater simulation toward more representative deep-sea operating conditions, which is particularly relevant for long-duration navigation and learning-based autonomy, where inaccurate sensor and environmental models introduce non-physical artifacts and overly optimistic performance. While challenges remain, including complex fluid-structure interactions and full environmental stochasticity, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for navigation, perception, and autonomy research under deep-sea conditions.
tldr: Extends the Stonefish simulator with deep-sea-specific physics and sensor models (hydrodynamics, IMU/DVL drift, magnetometer, terramechanics, underwater optics) for more realistic AUV/ROV/gilder simulation, targeting learning-based autonomy.
tldr_zh: 扩展了Stonefish仿真器，加入深海特有的物理与传感器模型（水动力学、IMU/DVL漂移、磁力计、地面力学、水下光学），以更真实地模拟AUV/ROV/水下滑翔机，服务于基于学习的自主控制。
summary_zh: 许多近期开发的水下模拟器在追求视觉真实感时牺牲了物理保真度，其重点在于浅水效应，这些效应在深海环境中相关性有限且计算成本高昂。本研究将重心转向深海物理真实感与传感器真实感。我们提出了Stonefish模拟器的物理与传感器扩展版本，通过引入随机IMU与DVL漂移、磁力计扰动、高阶水动力学、地面力学、压力驱动的环境变化以及基于物理的水下光学模型，增强了其水动力学模型。这些新增功能旨在更精准地刻画影响深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和水下滑翔机行为的力与测量数据，同时保持与实时仿真的兼容性。本研究推动了水下模拟向更具代表性的深海作业条件发展，尤其适用于长航时导航和基于学习的自主系统——在这些场景中，不准确的传感器与环境模型会引入非物理伪影并导致过于乐观的性能评估。尽管复杂流固耦合作用及完全环境随机性等挑战依然存在，但所提出的框架为深海条件下的导航、感知及自主系统研究提供了实用基础。

title: Online Joint Calibration of Steering Offset and Planar LiDAR Extrinsics for Wheeled Mobile Robots
summary: Accurate steering sensing and LiDAR-to-vehicle extrinsics are crucial for reliable path tracking in warehouse mobile robots (WMRs); miscalibration often leads to snaking, weaving, and elevated cross-track error (CTE). In practice, steering ``zero'' is commonly set manually (e.g., eyeballing straightness via a PS4 joystick), while LiDAR extrinsics are assumed from CAD and may drift after maintenance. Such static, manual procedures frequently cause miscalibration in safety-critical environments. This paper presents an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)--based method for online estimation of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics within a bicycle-kinematics model, providing a principled alternative to manual calibration. Experiments on real datasets show that correcting steering offset reduces CTE substantially, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
tldr: This paper proposes an EKF-based method for online joint calibration of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics for wheeled mobile robots, showing significant reduction in cross-track error in real-world tests.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波的方法，用于轮式移动机器人转向零偏与平面激光雷达外参的在线联合标定，实际测试证明能显著降低横向跟踪误差。
summary_zh: 精确的转向感知与激光雷达与车辆之间的外参校准对于仓储移动机器人的可靠路径跟踪至关重要；校准误差常导致蛇形偏摆、左右摇摆及横向跟踪误差增大。实际应用中，转向"零点"通常通过手动设定（例如使用PS4手柄目测直行状态），而激光雷达外参则依据CAD模型假设，且在维护后可能发生漂移。这种静态人工标定方式在安全关键环境中极易引发校准误差。本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波的方法，在自行车运动学模型框架下对转向偏移与平面激光雷达外参进行在线估计，为替代人工校准提供了理论化方案。真实数据集实验表明，校正转向偏移可显著降低横向跟踪误差，验证了所提方法的有效性。

title: Constraint-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Static Shape Estimation of Co-Manipulative Continuum Robots
summary: Static shape estimation of co-manipulative continuum robots (CCRs) is challenging because the continuum arms and manipulated flexible object form a closed chain that must satisfy both static equilibrium and geometric loop-closure constraints. This paper presents a constraint-aware physics-informed neural network (PINN) for static shape estimation of a tendon-driven CCR modeled using the geometric variable strain formulation. The proposed method incorporates a projected static equilibrium residual and a configuration-level geometric residual to enforce the governing mechanics and closed-chain geometry. In simulation, the PINN is compared with a purely data-driven artificial neural network (ANN) under limited and noisy training data. With 140 samples and 50% label noise, the PINN reduces the relative configuration error, equilibrium residual, and closed-chain residual by 67.88%, 67.35%, and 88.06%, respectively. Using the full dataset, the PINN achieves 0.1597% relative configuration error with an inference time of 0.1773 ms, compared with 17.97 s for an iterative nonlinear solver. Experimental fine-tuning reduces the marker RMSE from 2.657 mm to 0.497 mm and increases R2 from -0.788 to 0.937. These results demonstrate accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient static shape estimation of closed-chain CCRs.
tldr: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) is proposed for static shape estimation of co-manipulative continuum robots, incorporating projected static equilibrium and geometric loop-closure constraints to achieve accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient estimation.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于物理信息的神经网络（PINN），用于协作操控连续体机器人的静态形状估计，通过引入投影静态平衡和几何闭环约束，实现了准确、物理一致且计算高效的估计。
summary_zh: 协同操控连续体机器人（CCR）的静态形状估计具有挑战性，这是因为连续体臂与被操控的柔性对象构成闭合链条，必须同时满足静态平衡约束与几何闭环约束。本文提出了一种基于约束感知的物理信息神经网络（PINN），用于对采用几何变量应变公式建模的腱驱动CCR进行静态形状估计。该方法通过引入投影静态平衡残差与构型级几何残差，强制执行力学控制方程与闭环几何约束。在仿真中，将PINN与纯数据驱动的人工神经网络（ANN）在有限且有噪声的训练数据条件下进行了对比。当使用140个样本且标签噪声为50%时，PINN的相对构型误差、平衡残差和闭环残差分别降低了67.88%、67.35%和88.06%。使用完整数据集时，PINN的相对构型误差为0.1597%，推理时间为0.1773毫秒，而迭代非线性求解器则需要17.97秒。实验微调将标记点均方根误差从2.657毫米降至0.497毫米，并将R²从-0.788提升至0.937。这些结果表明，该方法能够对闭环CCR实现精确、物理一致且计算高效的静态形状估计。

title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
summary: High similarity between first-visit and return frames does not necessarily show that a video world model remembered the scene; the intervening rollout may simply have changed very little. This ambiguity makes absolute revisit scores sensitive to rendering stability, repetitive content, and failed motion. We introduce \emph{R2M-Bench} (\textbf{R}elative \textbf{R}evisit \textbf{M}emory Benchmark), a benchmark of observable revisit-selective consistency. For every detected return, R2M-Bench compares the revisit pair with two controls from the same rollout: a gap-matched non-revisit pair that measures generic temporal stability and a short-range pair that estimates short-horizon consistency. These comparisons produce \emph{MemoryGain} (MG), the revisit advantage over the temporal baseline, and the \emph{Normalized Memory Ratio} (NMR), which normalizes this advantage by the short-to-baseline dynamic range.
